questions.question: Which of the following practices is typically associated with folk beliefs in Europe?
choices: A: Performing meditations in temples.
B: Throwing salt over the shoulder to ward off bad luck.
C: Practicing yoga as a spiritual discipline.
D: Celebrating Diwali as the Festival of Lights.
questions.explanation: Throwing salt over the shoulder is a superstition meant to ward off bad luck and is common in various European cultures. In contrast, meditation and yoga are more associated with Eastern spiritual traditions.
